sources_tested: Local corpus paths (no tlg0541.tlg048 text); PerseusCatalog exact CTS record; Austin 1973 introductory concordance; targeted Jäkel I–XX/papyrus searches; P.Vindob. G 19999 A/B scholarly notices; KHM item-level record; scan_sources check
open_text_result: No exact reusable transcription of Jäkel papyrus fragments I–XX was verified. The freely displayed ps.-Menander version A is a different later textual transmission and cannot be substituted without fragment-by-fragment concordance.
scan_result: The target is a composite of 20 distinct papyrus/ostracon/tablet fragments. Concrete members include P.Vindob. G 19999 A (Jäkel Pap. IV) and B (Pap. V); KHM INV 8594f is catalogued as Menander-Sentenzen but its Jäkel-fragment number was not established. KHM permits downloads only for private purposes.
next_action: build an I–XX witness concordance (repository, inventory, lines, image licence) and seek an explicitly open image per fragment before any own OCR
notes: Austin confirms Jäkel's I–XX pp.3–25 and notes three later additions; these are not silently folded into this Canon scope. Jäkel 1964 and its apparatus remain protected. No provider OCR or local image was used.
